---
applyTo: "packages/motion/**"
---

Compile upstream Motion dependencies through the native Rslib/Rspack plugin in `build/pluginLynxRuntime.ts`, using ProvidePlugin for private runtime imports and DefinePlugin for their typeof guards. Keep the zero-configuration supported API catalog in `build/lynxRuntimePreset.ts`; it is independent of Motion exports. Do not add a Babel wrapper or substitution loader. The adapter remains bundleless to preserve ReactLynx main-thread directives and shared import attributes; `src/upstream` entries are bundled separately with their transitive dependencies included. Keep full and mini vendor exports narrow so mini does not acquire the full DOM runtime.

Do not install DOM or scheduling polyfills on globals or assign to the Lynx for Web lexical `window`. Lynx main-thread elements are not browser DOM nodes even in a browser host. Keep the private runtime external to the vendor bundles so its ElementCompt constructor is shared with the adapter and instanceof checks remain valid, and its own host API lookups are not substituted recursively.

When updating Motion or adding an upstream API, audit its reachable host API accesses and extend the private runtime and transform together. Babel syntax transforms and core-js do not implement Lynx DOM behavior. Keep scope-aware replacements for bare globals and static globalThis accesses, including typeof checks, without rewriting local bindings or object keys. Validate the built ESM in a separate process with absent and read-only browser globals; source-only tests cannot validate substitutions inside dependencies.

Include `build/**` in the Motion Turbo inputs and cache `dist/**` so changes to the runtime transform invalidate the build and generated vendor chunks are restored with the adapter. Normalize filesystem paths returned by the Vitest resolver to forward slashes for Windows.

Exercise compiled Mini core modules with their real callable registry and vendor spring/easing code in subprocess feature tests, alongside full Motion with absent and read-only host globals. Native/Web feature pages should assert observed state and cleanup; wait for native computed styles to converge after Mini completion, since the final value notification can precede the engine style flush. Allow pixel rounding when comparing computed dimensions. Keep interactive feature cases in the existing Motion demo navigation and build them with the normal example configuration. Preserve the standalone Mini entry and isolated compiled-artifact tests for dependency-graph checks. Call root.render only in entry modules; components imported by the demo must not mount a second root. Keep pre-existing ReactLynx worklet reachability issues outside Motion build-format changes.

The effect-started Motion values case temporarily anchors its ordinary Motion import with `useMemo(() => springValue, [])` while issue #4244 is open. Preserve this example-only workaround until the compiler can inject definitions that depend on shared imports. Do not replace public worklet imports with shared imports: that bypasses descriptor hydration. The integrated demo shares a module graph with other cases and cannot independently reproduce this compiler issue. Verify any workaround removal with an isolated compiler reproduction and runtime animation, since other hooks or callbacks in the same entry can hide the missing-definition path.

Keep the bundled upstream Motion packages in devDependencies and do not add Babel as a build dependency. Bundle declarations for both public entry points with upstream Motion types included; moving only package.json dependencies breaks consumers whose declarations still import upstream types. Rslib's bundleless JavaScript glob entries and its declaration entry configuration are separate: keep the JavaScript glob in lib.source.entry and set explicit public declaration entries through modifyEnvironmentConfig. Validate the packed package in an isolated production install without upstream Motion or Babel packages and typecheck both entry points.

Keep private runtime modules split so selecting a scheduler does not import the DOM adapter. Test no-reference, typeof-only, shadowed, and dead-branch fixtures for zero imports and single-API fixtures for only their required modules. Animation frame scheduling must use a matching host request/cancel pair with its receiver, or a matching timer fallback. Probe upgrades through `build/rslib.compat.config.ts` with an isolated MOTION_COMPAT_ROOT installation; do not change production pins or overwrite dist just to test another version. Report compiler success, compiled runtime checks, Web/device validation, and untested new upstream APIs separately.
